title: Create the SCMTips-Field repo skeleton
description: Create the private repo SCMTips-Field with the BRIEF directory layout, README, .editorconfig, .gitignore (excludes .env*, *.pem, reports/tmp) and docs/SPEC/ holding BRIEF.md and the Phase 1 spec. Add empty package markers so every path in the layout exists.
done_when: Tree matches BRIEF section 3; no file from the SCMTips core repo is copied. FR1.001

title: Set up the Python workspace with uv
description: Create a uv workspace (pyproject.toml, uv.lock) with members services/field-api, services/field-worker, services/erp-sim, connectors/sap, compat, tools/fake-core. Pin Python 3.13, ruff, mypy --strict, pytest, hypothesis, schemathesis.
done_when: uv sync --frozen succeeds on a clean host; ruff and mypy run from the root. FR1.001

title: Set up the TypeScript workspace with pnpm
description: Create pnpm-workspace.yaml with apps/field-console and packages/ui-tokens, packages/field-contract, packages/core-contract; TypeScript strict, ESLint flat config, Vitest, fast-check, Playwright, axe-core.
done_when: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds; tsc --noEmit passes on empty packages. FR1.001

title: Write docker-compose.dev.yml for the local stack
description: Compose postgres:16 (databases field and erpsim, roles field_migrator, field_app, field_worker, erpsim_app), otel-collector, jaeger, erp-sim, field-api, field-worker and tools/fake-core. Health checks gate start order.
done_when: docker compose up brings all services healthy within 90 s. FR1.007

title: Build the verify-all runner
description: Write scripts/verify-all.sh that runs each job in isolation, captures exit code, duration and log path, prints a fixed-width PASS/FAIL/SKIP table and writes reports/verify-all/<UTC timestamp>.json. Support --only, --skip and --fast; exit 1 if any job FAILs.
done_when: A deliberately failing fixture job turns the table row FAIL and the exit code 1 (TC1.101). FR1.001 FR1.002

title: Add lint, typecheck, unit, property and contract jobs
description: Wire ruff, mypy, eslint, tsc, pytest -m unit, pytest -m property (Hypothesis profile ci: 500 examples, derandomized seed in report), vitest, and Schemathesis against packages/field-contract/openapi.json.
done_when: Each job appears in the table and fails on an injected defect. FR1.001 FR1.008

title: Add the Alembic round-trip job
description: Job alembic runs upgrade head, downgrade base, upgrade head on throwaway databases for field and erpsim, then compares pg_dump --schema-only of the first and last upgrade.
done_when: Schema diff is empty; a migration without downgrade fails the job (TC1.107). FR1.028

title: Add Semgrep 1.181.0 and Trivy jobs
description: Pin semgrep==1.181.0; vendor public rule folders (python, typescript, generic secrets, dockerfile) under tools/semgrep/rules with the source commit hash in RULES.lock; run with --metrics=off --error. Trivy fs and config scans fail on HIGH/CRITICAL with a fix available; .trivyignore entries need an expiry date.
done_when: Seeded vulnerable fixture fails each job (TC1.104, TC1.105). FR1.003

title: Write the names and firewall checks
description: tools/checks/names.py scans tracked text files against tools/checks/names_denylist.txt (real company and person names) and requires SAMPLE prefixes in seed data. tools/checks/firewall.py forbids imports of core code, HTTP calls to core outside packages/core-contract, model ids ending in -contributor, and cross-service imports (field-api must not import erp_sim; connectors must not import field_api).
done_when: Each rule has a failing fixture (TC1.102, TC1.103). FR1.004 FR1.005

title: Record branch, commit and review conventions
description: Write docs/CONTRIBUTING.md: branches f<phase>/<ws>-<slug>, Conventional Commits with work package scope (feat(f0-ws5): ...), push after every work package. Add a commit-msg hook and the conventions job, CODEOWNERS (role aliases), docs/adr/0000-template.md and ADR-0001 monorepo, ADR-0002 sim-first ERP, ADR-0003 auth bridge.
done_when: Non-conforming commit message fails the conventions job (TC1.106). FR1.006

title: Create the field-api app factory
description: services/field-api/src/field_api/app.py builds the FastAPI app with pydantic-settings config (FIELD_* keys), lifespan for DB pool and JWKS cache, router registry under /v1 and the fixed middleware order: request id, tracing, auth, tenant, idempotency, ETag.
done_when: App starts with docker compose; unknown route returns problem+json 404. FR1.009

title: Implement health and readiness
description: GET /v1/health returns 200 without dependencies. GET /v1/ready checks DB (SELECT 1 under 200 ms), Alembic head equals code head, JWKS cache age below FIELD_JWKS_MAX_STALE_S and erp-sim reachability (warn only).
done_when: DB stopped gives 503 with failing check names (TC1.108). FR1.007

title: Build the problem+json error registry
description: field_api/errors.py defines FieldError(code, status, title) and a registry; handlers convert validation, HTTP and unhandled errors into RFC 9457 bodies with type urn:scmtips-field:problem:<code>, instance, request_id. tools/gen_error_codes.py writes docs/ERROR_CODES.md.
done_when: PR1.12 passes; every code matches FIELD-<AREA>-<status>-<SLUG>. FR1.009 PR1.12

title: Add request id and structured logging
description: Middleware accepts X-Request-Id matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,128}$, otherwise generates a UUIDv7; echoes it on every response. JSON logs via structlog with a redaction processor for Authorization, tokens, crop refs and email-like strings.
done_when: TC1.117 and TC1.159 pass. FR1.015 FR1.063

title: Instrument OpenTelemetry and RED metrics
description: Use opentelemetry-instrumentation for FastAPI, SQLAlchemy and httpx; W3C traceparent in and out; histogram field_http_server_duration_seconds by route and status; attribute allowlist so no header values or bodies are recorded.
done_when: Trace from fake phone to erp-sim shares one trace id in Jaeger (TC1.118). FR1.016

title: Implement UUIDv7 generation
description: libs field_common/uuid7.py implements RFC 9562 UUIDv7 with 48-bit ms timestamp and a 12-bit monotonic counter in rand_a; SQL function field.uuid_generate_v7() for defaults; all primary keys use it.
done_when: PR1.11 passes with 1,000,000 ids per run in under 2 s. FR1.014 PR1.11

title: Build the Idempotency-Key middleware and store
description: Require Idempotency-Key on every POST except /v1/auth/exchange. Fingerprint = sha256(method, path, principal_id, canonical JSON body). Insert field.idempotency_record in_progress, run handler, store status, headers and body; replay with Idempotent-Replayed: true; 422 on fingerprint mismatch; 409 with Retry-After: 1 while in progress.

title: Add ETag and If-Match handling
description: ETag is a strong tag derived from (id, version). GET honours If-None-Match with 304; PATCH and PUT require If-Match (428 if missing, 412 if stale) and increment version in the same UPDATE ... WHERE version = :v.
done_when: PR1.10 and TC1.115 pass. FR1.012 PR1.10

title: Add cursor pagination
description: Keyset pagination on id (UUIDv7) with an HMAC-signed opaque cursor holding last id and filter hash; limit default 50, max 200; response {items, next_cursor}.
done_when: PR1.09 and TC1.116 pass. FR1.013 PR1.09

title: Set tenant context per request
description: DB session dependency opens a transaction and calls set_config('app.tenant_id', :tid, true) and set_config('app.site_ids', :csv, true) from the verified principal before any query; no principal means no session.
done_when: TC1.120 passes; unset tenant returns zero rows (PR1.04). FR1.030 PR1.04

title: Export the field-api OpenAPI and generate clients
description: tools/export_openapi.py writes packages/field-contract/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1); verify-all contract job fails if the file drifts from code. Generate TypeScript (openapi-typescript) and Kotlin (openapi-generator kotlin) clients into packages/field-contract/gen/.
done_when: Drift fixture fails the job; Schemathesis run passes (TC1.110). FR1.008

title: Implement site, location, material and device endpoints
description: Routes API1.04-API1.13 as first consumers of the middleware, using permission dependencies from T1.039. Lists use pagination, updates use If-Match, creates use Idempotency-Key.
done_when: Schemathesis and integration tests for API1.04-API1.13 pass. FR1.031 FR1.032 FR1.023

title: Create the field-worker skeleton
description: services/field-worker runs loops: outbox relay (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED batches of 100), idempotency purge (hourly, expires_at < now()), probe cleanup (24 h). Each loop sets app.tenant_id per claimed row via field.claim_* SECURITY DEFINER functions.
done_when: PR1.19 and TC1.166 pass. FR1.033 PR1.19

title: Write migration field_0001 baseline
description: Alembic env for services/field-api; field_0001 creates schema field, roles grants (field_app NOBYPASSRLS, no DELETE on erp_document), function field.uuid_generate_v7(), trigger function field.touch_updated_at(), tables idempotency_record and outbox with forced RLS.
done_when: Round trip clean (TC1.107). FR1.028

title: Write migration field_0002 data model v1
description: Create site, location, material, device, task, task_line, capture, erp_document, posting_job with all columns, checks, indexes and foreign keys from ts.json data_model.
done_when: All tables exist with listed indexes; TC1.107 passes. FR1.028 FR1.029

title: Apply forced RLS and the catalog check
description: For every field.* table: ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, policy tenant_isolation USING and WITH CHECK nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid = tenant_id. tests/security/test_rls_catalog.py asserts relforcerowsecurity and that field_app lacks BYPASSRLS.
done_when: TC1.119 and PR1.04 pass. FR1.029 PR1.04

title: Add site data-scope policies
description: Policy site_scope on site, location, task, task_line, capture, erp_document: current_setting('app.site_ids', true) = '*' or site_id = any(string_to_array(...)::uuid[]). Scope comes from role_grant.site_ids.
done_when: TC1.121 passes. FR1.031

title: Enforce the location hierarchy
description: Trigger field.location_validate checks allowed parent kinds (site root: zone or tower; zone>aisle>rack>level>position; tower>sector>level>position), same site as parent, depth <= 6, no cycles on move, and rebuilds path for the moved subtree.
done_when: PR1.20 and TC1.171 pass. FR1.032 PR1.20

title: Build the material cache sync
description: field-worker job material_sync pages ErpPort.list_materials(plant) and upserts field.material on (tenant_id, erp_material_no, plant); records synced_at and source_hash; marks deleted_in_erp_at after 3 absent syncs.
done_when: TC1.167 passes against SAMPLE seed (50 materials). FR1.034

title: Write migration field_0003 interim role grants
description: Create field.role_grant (CS-02 interim) with partial unique index on active grants and RLS. Bootstrap command field-api grant --tenant --user --role field.admin for first admin, audited to outbox.
done_when: Grant and revoke round trip; TC1.126 passes. FR1.022

title: Inventory the core-p13 endpoints the add-on needs
description: Read the core-p13 OpenAPI (read-only) and list each path the add-on would call with method, purpose and whether it exists. Write compat/USED_ENDPOINTS.yaml and resolve D1.05; anything missing becomes a seam entry.
done_when: Every used path is marked exists or seam with a CS id. FR1.024 FR1.026

title: Generate packages/core-contract for core-p13
description: Commit specs/core-p13.json with sha256; generate a Python client (openapi-python-client) and TypeScript types (openapi-typescript) with pinned versions in GENERATOR.lock; verify-all regenerates and compares hashes.
done_when: Regeneration is byte-identical (TC1.127). FR1.025

title: Build the compat suite
description: compat/tests run per used endpoint: schema presence, required request fields, response fields read by the add-on, auth scheme. compat/diff.py wraps oasdiff with the used-endpoint filter; compat/mutations/ holds 5 seeded breaking specs.
done_when: Passes on core-p13; fails on 5 of 5 mutations (TC1.128, TC1.129, PR1.13). FR1.026 FR1.027 PR1.13

title: Plan the core-p14 compat column
description: compat/MATRIX.md and the compat job accept a list of tags; core-p14 shows SKIPPED-PENDING until specs/core-p14.json exists; a diff report core-p13 to core-p14 is produced automatically when it does.
done_when: core-p14 row reads SKIPPED-PENDING, never PASS. FR1.026

title: Build tools/fake-core for development
description: Small FastAPI app that serves JWKS with rotating Ed25519 keys, issues core-style session JWTs and P10-style device JWTs (claims per docs/CORE_SEAMS.md assumptions), and a device status endpoint with revocation. Never used outside dev and tests.
done_when: Contract matches assumptions recorded in CS-01 and CS-07. FR1.018 FR1.021

title: Implement JWT verification with JWKS caching
description: field_api/auth/jwks.py fetches and caches JWKS (FIELD_JWKS_TTL_S), refreshes once on unknown kid, allows only EdDSA and RS256/ES256 per config, checks iss, aud, exp, nbf with 60 s skew.
done_when: TC1.123 and TC1.125 pass. FR1.019 FR1.021

title: Implement POST /v1/auth/exchange
description: Accepts a core-signed device or session JWT plus device_id; checks signature, device binding fingerprint, device status and revocation; issues a field token (EdDSA, aud scmtips-field, TTL min(600 s, core exp - now)) with tenant, sub, device, roles and permissions.
done_when: PR1.17 and TC1.122 pass. FR1.018 FR1.019 PR1.17

title: Handle device revocation
description: Device status poll every FIELD_DEVICE_POLL_S (default 60) against core (or fake-core); on revoked: set field.device.status, add jti to deny list until token expiry, emit device.revoked. POST /v1/devices/{id}/revoke does the same locally.
done_when: TC1.124 passes; revoked token fails within 60 s. FR1.020

title: Define the role-to-permission map
description: field_api/auth/permissions.py maps the 7 field.* roles to field.<area>.<verb> permissions, applies the glasses restriction (CS-07 interim) and exposes require_perm(). Map is exported to docs/PERMISSIONS.md.
done_when: TC1.126 passes; docs match code. FR1.022

title: Write docs/CORE_SEAMS.md
description: For CS-01..CS-09 record gap, interim, assumption, test hook (test id), risk if absent and the shape requested from core in Phase 5. Owner reviews.
done_when: TC1.130 passes; owner sign-off line filled. FR1.024

title: Create the erp-sim app skeleton
description: services/erp-sim FastAPI app with OData-like conventions: base /sap/opu/odata/sap/<SERVICE>/, {"d": ...} envelopes, $filter eq, $expand, $top/$skip, CSRF token fetch emulation, sap-client header (default 100), SAP-style error body {error:{code, message:{lang, value}}}.
done_when: Unknown entity returns ZSIM/404 error body. FR1.035

title: Write migration erpsim_0001
description: Schema erpsim: document, document_item, number_range, enqueue_lock, dedupe, stock, equipment_install, fault_rule, plus master tables material, plant, storage_location, functional_location. Separate Alembic chain (D1.02).
done_when: Round trip clean in the alembic job. FR1.028

title: Implement number range allocation
description: erp_sim/numbering.py allocates with UPDATE number_range SET current = current + 1 WHERE object = :o AND client = :c AND current < upper RETURNING current, inside the posting transaction. Ranges per BRIEF; material documents also carry doc_year.
done_when: PR1.05 passes with 32 concurrent workers. FR1.042 PR1.05

title: Implement enqueue locks
description: erp_sim/locks.py acquires (object_type, object_key) with INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING plus TTL takeover after FIELD_SIM_LOCK_TTL_S; returns ZSIM/LOCKED with holder and object in SAP-like text; releases at end of the logical unit of work.
done_when: PR1.06 and TC1.138 pass. FR1.043 PR1.06

title: Build inbound delivery read and goods receipt

done_when: TC1.131 and TC1.132 pass. FR1.035 FR1.036

title: Build outbound delivery pick and goods issue

done_when: TC1.133 passes. FR1.037

title: Build physical inventory documents

title: Build material document create and reverse

title: Build equipment create, install and dismantle

done_when: TC1.136 passes. FR1.040

title: Build maintenance order, notification and measurement documents

title: Implement idempotency dedupe

done_when: PR1.08 and TC1.139 pass. FR1.045 PR1.08

title: Build the fault injection API

title: Seed SAMPLE master and transactional data

POST /_sim/reset truncates and reseeds deterministically.

A test-only enqueue helper creates jobs; no public posting endpoint in Phase 1.
